Amerika ne chin ki AI aur semikandaktar kshamta ko simit karne ke lie takniki pratibandh aur sakht kar die hain. Nvidia ke edvansd AI Chips se lekar Data Centers aur Cloud Computing tak, janie amerika kaise chin ki unnat taknik tak pahunch rok raha hai aur iska chin ki tek indastri par kya asar par sakta hai.
Thank you for watching our video!
